lines.text: Many learners say: I wake up on six o'clock.
Better: I wake up at six o'clock.
At! The class starts at 9 o'clock.

data.wrong: I wake up on six o'clock.
data.right: I wake up at six o'clock.

native.tip: Kita bilang “pada jam enam”, tapi untuk jam bahasa Inggris pakai at, bukan on.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “I wake up on six o'clock.” 😅 Untuk jam, pakai at: “I wake up at six o'clock.” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “at”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “I wake up at six o'clock.” Lalu ganti jamnya dengan jam bangunmu. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “pada jam enam”, but for clock time English uses at, not on.
en.caption: Ever say this? “I wake up on six o'clock.” 😅 For clock time, use at: “I wake up at six o'clock.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
